description: [Kampala] Public Transport Routes is a data set listed in Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue), a transport data catalogue, published or maintained by Transport for Cairo. The routes line-strings layer represents the geographic traces of onboard trips for various public transportation routes. Each route is recorded as two separate entries, depicting its inbound and outbound paths, and was collected during the Greater Kampala Metropolitan Area Paratransit & Street Usage Study in 2020. Coverage: Uganda. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for Cairo. Its tags are GKMA, Kampala, Popular Transport, Public Transport, Routes. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEOJSON, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tdc-portal.
